description: Statistics of the developers' offer market in one city: the number of offers, investments and developers, the distribution of prices (PLN), prices per m² (PLN/m²) and areas (m²) as min, p25, median, p75 and max, and the largest developers by number of offers (developer_slug, offers, investments, median_price_per_m2, developer_url; developer_slug is an identifier — the developer's name is not part of the result). Optionally only offers within a price and area range. Use it when the question is about a city's market (typical prices, who has the most offers), not about particular flats. Limits: active offers only (no archived) and one city only (city_slug from deweloperuch_search_locations; polska does not work). The figures are computed here from the site's compact list of the city's active offers (the list itself never leaves; Warsaw's is 1.3 MB, so a call can take a few seconds) and can differ slightly from the site's own offer totals. These are developers' asking prices, not transaction prices. Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Fields ending in _url are pages of deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Result shape: { city_slug, offers (matching active offers), investments, developers, price?, price_per_m2?, area_m2? (each { min, p25, median, p75, max }), top_developers: [{ developer_slug, offers, investments, median_price_per_m2?, developer_url? }], developers_returned, developers_omitted, truncated, hint? (also explains an empty result), list_url? (the same offers on deweloperuch.pl), source } — the list key is `top_developers`.

city.description: city_slug of one city from deweloperuch_search_locations, e.g. krakow (not polska).

top_developers.description: How many of the largest developers to show, 1–30. Default 10.

name: deweloperuch_get_market_statistics
title: City offer market statistics
